treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — multimodal connectivity index using Transportation Performance Scorecard. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — multimodal connectivity index measured biannually. Target: 20% connectivity improvement.
